jobs.description: Join Albert Heijn Online in Amersfoort as a delivery driver. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The option to receive your salary weekly or every four weeks. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amersfoort As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure online grocery orders reach customers in Amersfoort and the surrounding area. At the beginning of your shift, you check the route planned for you and prepare for departure. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to your first customer. At each stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully and provide friendly service. If the customer has empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Then it is time for the next address. This makes every shift a combination of driving and physical activity. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and carry grocery crates. At the same time, you have the freedom and responsibility of completing your route independently. Once all orders have been delivered, you return to the location in Amersfoort and complete your shift. Do I need previous experience? Is Saturday availability mandatory? Yes. You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. What does a typical shift involve? You drive between customers, deliver their grocery orders and provide friendly service at the door. The role also involves regular physical activity, including lifting grocery crates, walking to customers' homes and getting in and out of the delivery van throughout your shift. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like an active driving job in Amersfoort? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online.
